title: SynaptoDeck Features Manifest
description: Single source of truth for the SynaptoDeck feature inventory. Edited in the same commit as the code change. Marketing site fetches this and regenerates on every build.

_doc.description: Free-form maintainer notes; not consumed by the marketing site.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Used as URL fragment, render key, and the join key to screenshots/<id>.png. Never change — if a feature is replaced, retire the old id + add a new one.

status.description: live = shipped in current version. beta = behind a flag. planned = on the roadmap. deprecated = still rendered but with a sunset note.

versionIntroduced.description: The release tag that introduced this feature. Required for status=live/beta/deprecated.

plannedVersion.description: Target version for status=planned. Free-form (e.g. 'v0.89.x' or 'TBD').

description.description: One-line internal description — what it does technically. For maintainers reading the manifest, not for marketing display.

marketingCopy.description: 1-2 sentence user-facing copy. The marketing site renders this as the feature card body. Conversational tone, what-it-gives-you not what-it-is. Reference SynaptoDeck by name where natural.

icon.description: lucide-react icon component name (e.g. 'Sparkles', 'Keyboard'). The marketing site imports and renders these dynamically.

screenshot.description: Optional path to a screenshot (relative to the marketing site's public/ dir). The marketing site renders the screenshot above marketingCopy if the file exists.
